ns2:course.label: Actuarial Models for Financial Economics
ns2:course.description: Theoretical basis of financial models and their applications to insurance and other financial risks. Topics include derivative markets, no-arbitrage pricing of financial derivatives, interest rate models, dynamic hedging and other risk management techniques. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Credit is not given for MATH 476 and MATH 567. Prerequisite: MATH 409 or MATH 464.
